snippet.title: Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos: Joey the Passion (PC) Playthrough Part 1
snippet.description:
This is a playthrough of the third and final part of the Yu-Gi-Oh! Power of Chaos series: Joey the Passion, facing a match duel against Joey and his Brooklyn Rage! This is Part 1 of the playthrough as I plan to duel him again just to show off his variety of decks in the game.

This was originally a broadcast from Twitch, brung here to all its glory...

No doubt that this is the best in the series as it has some improvements and even some neat additions. This time the card count is about 700, and while still fairly low when compared to other Yu-Gi-Oh! games of the time period (mainly the GBA games), it features a bigger variety of cards and does provide some more then-exclusive cards to the game. Also, the cards you gained from the previous POC games can be used here if you owned the other two.

The opponent Joey is the best in terms of difficulty and challenge (a bit ironic since he is usually below Yugi and Kaiba in terms of skill and overall victories). Anyways, he can be pretty difficult at times, be a tricky bastard and throw off some serious moves (did I really just say that...?) that can be hard to get out of. Even with good cards, it can't always guarantee a victory against him. Not only that, he can pick out a variety of decks to use on you that really changes the way to defeat him. For example, one time he may use an Exodia deck, and another, he utilizes a WATER attribute deck etc. It does build up the replay value a bit to make you keep playing this more for extra cards. To make it better, they also allowed the ability to play against a human opponent via LAN (and soon online with the use of a great program known as GameRanger).

And again sounding like a broken record, the voice clips for Joey were provided by 4Kids voice actor Wayne Grayson. Like always, it's okay for a while, but it gets old soon enough...

Grade: C+

Developer: Konami
Publisher: Konami
Year: 2004
Platforms: PC

This is only for the sake of entertainment. Enjoy!

2014 Eric Corp Incorporated
